projectionWideLimitations.note: Descriptions may expose semantic result/validation contracts that are not structurally encoded.
projectionWideLimitations.batch2StrongestGenericization: GitHub.create_tree.tree_elements items are projected only as { [key: string]: any }.

actions.description: Create a top-level PR Conversation comment (Issue comment).

repo_full_name.description: Repository in owner/name form; maps to REST owner/repo path parameters.

actions.resourceScope: Top-level conversation / issue comment associated with a pull request.

actions.description: Add assignees to an issue or pull request. Returns a normalized issue snapshot after the mutation.

assignees.description: GitHub usernames to add; additive to existing assignees.
semanticLimits: Endpoint supports up to 10 assignees; no schema-level maxItems projected.

actions.resourceScope: Issue or pull request assignee collection.

resultContract.description: Normalized issue snapshot after mutation; snapshot fields are not projected.

actions.description: Add labels to an issue or pull request. Returns a normalized issue snapshot after the mutation.

labels.description: Labels to add; additive, unlike update_issue(labels=...) which replaces the full set.

actions.resourceScope: Issue or pull request labels.

resultContract.description: Normalized issue snapshot after mutation; snapshot fields are not projected.

actions.description: Add a reaction to an issue comment.

comment_id.description: Numeric issue or review comment ID.

reaction.description: Reaction identifier such as +1 or eyes; examples only, no enum projected.

actions.resourceScope: Reaction on an issue comment.

actions.description: Add a reaction to a GitHub pull request.

reaction.description: Reaction identifier such as +1 or eyes; examples only, no enum projected.

actions.resourceScope: Reaction on a pull request.

actions.description: Add a reaction to a pull request review comment.

comment_id.description: Numeric issue or review comment ID.

reaction.description: Reaction identifier such as +1 or eyes; examples only, no enum projected.

actions.resourceScope: Reaction on a pull-request review comment.

actions.description: Add a review to a GitHub pull request. review is required for REQUEST_CHANGES and COMMENT events.

position.description: Position in diff, counted below @@ hunk header and across hunks until a new file.

line.description: File line number for line-based comments.

side.description: Diff side; LEFT/RIGHT are examples, not enum values.

start_side.description: Diff side for start_line; no enum projected.

commit_id.description: Optional commit SHA to anchor the review.

conditionalRules: review required when action is COMMENT
review required when action is REQUEST_CHANGES
No machine-readable rule projected for position versus line or multi-line field combinations.
actions.resourceScope: Pull-request review submission, optionally with inline file comments and anchoring commit.

actions.description: Compare two commits/refs and return per-file stats plus compare metadata. Thin wrapper around GithubPlugin.compare_commits with a stable, compact response shape.
actions.resourceScope: Comparison between two repository commits/refs.

resultContract.description: Stable compact response containing per-file statistics and compare metadata; properties/types not projected.

actions.description: Convert an open pull request back to draft state. Returns the connector normalized PR snapshot after the transition.
conditionalRules: Description scopes transition to an open pull request.
actions.resourceScope: Pull-request draft state.

resultContract.description: Normalized PR snapshot after transition; snapshot fields not projected.

actions.description: Create a blob in the repository and return its SHA.
actions.resourceScope: Git data blob object in a repository.

resultContract.description: Returns blob SHA; wrapping as raw string versus object is not projected.

actions.description: Create a new branch from exactly one existing commit SHA or base ref.

base_ref.description: Existing branch, tag, or commit ref.

conditionalRules: Exactly one of sha or base_ref must be provided; XOR is descriptive, not structurally encoded.
actions.resourceScope: Repository branch / Git ref creation from an existing commit or ref.

actions.description: Create a commit pointing to tree_sha with one or more parents.
actions.resourceScope: Git commit object, including multi-parent commits.

actions.description: Create a new UTF-8 text file through GitHub contents API. Returns only the resulting commit SHA, not GitHub full content/commit payload.

path.description: New file path; must not already exist on target branch.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 text contents; wrapper Base64-encodes for GitHub contents API.

branch.description: Existing branch; null means repository default branch; does not create a branch.

conditionalRules: Target path must not already exist on target branch.
Branch, when supplied, is an existing branch.
actions.resourceScope: Repository contents/file creation plus resulting commit.

resultContract.description: Returns only resulting commit SHA; exact wrapping not projected.

actions.description: Create a GitHub issue. Returns a normalized issue snapshot, not GitHub raw REST payload.
actions.resourceScope: Repository issue creation with optional metadata.

resultContract.description: Normalized issue snapshot; snapshot fields not projected.

actions.description: Open a pull request in the repository. Returns connector normalized PR snapshot, not full REST response payload.

title.description: Title; required unless issue is supplied.

issue.description: Existing issue number to convert into a pull request.

head_repo.description: Repository where head branch lives; required by GitHub for some same-organization cross-repository PRs.

maintainer_can_modify.description: Whether maintainers may modify the PR branch.

conditionalRules: title required unless issue is supplied.
head_repo required by GitHub for some same-organization cross-repository pull requests.
No precedence, mutual-exclusion, equality, or conflict-resolution rule is projected between head_branch/head or base_branch/base.
The projected schema does not mark head/head_branch/base/base_branch as unconditionally required.
actions.resourceScope: Pull-request creation, including draft, issue conversion, and some cross-repository heads.

resultContract.description: Normalized PR snapshot; snapshot fields not projected.

actions.description: Create a tree object in the repository from the given elements.

repository_full_name.description: Repository in owner/name form; maps to REST owner/repo path parameters.

tree_elements.description: Tree entries to include in the new tree object.

base_tree_sha.description: Optional base tree SHA to build on; null creates from scratch.

conditionalRules: Inner tree-entry properties, required fields, enums, modes, types, and path rules are not projected and must not be inferred.
actions.resourceScope: Git tree object in a repository.

actions.description: Delete a file through GitHub contents API. Returns only the resulting commit SHA.

sha.description: Current blob SHA, usually obtained from fetch_file.

branch.description: Optional branch; null means default branch.

actions.resourceScope: Repository contents/file deletion plus resulting commit.

resultContract.description: Returns only resulting commit SHA; raw string versus wrapped field is not projected.

actions.description: Dismiss a submitted pull request review. Returns the normalized review snapshot after dismissal.

review_id.description: GraphQL pull request review node ID.

message.description: Dismissal message explaining why the review is dismissed.

actions.resourceScope: Submitted pull-request review addressed by GraphQL review node ID.

resultContract.description: Normalized review snapshot after dismissal; normalized fields are not projected.

actions.description: Download a GitHub private user image attachment URL. Use only for private-user-images.githubusercontent.com URLs; use fetch/fetch_file for repository files.

semanticLimits: Repository files must use fetch or fetch_file.

actions.resourceScope: GitHub private user image attachments in issues or pull requests.

resultContract.description: Download/file result is projected as any; file-reference fields, bytes representation, metadata, and MIME information are not exposed.

descriptiveRejections: Unsupported URL families are excluded by the contract.

actions.description: Download a GitHub Actions workflow artifact ZIP archive. Client follows GitHub temporary redirect and returns a reusable file reference for ZIP bytes.

file_name.description: Optional ZIP file name for returned file reference.

actions.resourceScope: GitHub Actions workflow artifact archive.

resultContract.description: Connector follows temporary redirect and returns a reusable file reference for ZIP bytes; file-reference schema is not projected.

actions.description: Enable auto-merge for a pull request. Wrapper infers merge method from repository settings and returns only success.
conditionalRules: Merge method is inferred from repository settings; no merge-method input is exposed.
actions.resourceScope: Pull-request auto-merge configuration.

resultContract.description: Returns only success; representation/type of success is not projected.

actions.description: Fetch approved public GitHub repository resources and repository files through an allowlisted GET-only surface. JSON is returned unchanged; oversized/non-UTF-8 responses are rejected and binary downloads are unsupported.

semanticLimits: Non-public-GitHub hosts and unlisted endpoint families are rejected.
Sensitive user, organization, and secrets API families are unsupported.
Contents URLs without ref use repository default branch.
Responses must be UTF-8 text; oversized/non-UTF-8 responses rejected; binary downloads unsupported.
Active repository permissions apply; managed GitHub App installations lack administration access for endpoints that require it.

pagination.behavior: No connector-level page/cursor/continuation fields or automatic pagination contract is projected.

actions.resourceScope: Broad approved public GitHub repository-resource GET surface.

resultContract.description: JSON responses returned unchanged; UTF-8 text supported; no union output schema projected.

permissionNotes: Managed GitHub App installations cannot read branch-protection endpoints that require administration permission.

actions.description: Fetch blob content by SHA from the given repository.
actions.resourceScope: Git blob object content.

resultContract.description: Blob content returned, but content field, encoding, SHA, size, truncation model, and object schema are not projected.

actions.description: Fetch a commit with its metadata, diff, and canonical URL.
actions.resourceScope: Repository commit.

resultContract.description: Contains commit metadata, diff, and canonical URL; exact properties/nested types are not projected.

actions.description: Fetch GitHub Actions workflow runs associated with a commit SHA. Wrapper filters to pull-request-triggered runs and returns the first page only.
conditionalRules: Wrapper filters to pull-request-triggered workflow runs.
actions.resourceScope: GitHub Actions workflow runs associated with a commit, filtered to PR-triggered runs.

resultContract.description: Workflow-run collection schema is not projected.

actions.description: Fetch file content by repository path, using the default branch when ref is omitted.

ref.description: Optional branch, tag, or commit ref; default branch used when omitted.

conditionalRules: No projected relation such as end_line >= start_line; do not infer one.
actions.resourceScope: Repository file content at optional branch/tag/commit ref.

resultContract.description: No path/SHA/content/encoding/truncation/line metadata output schema is projected.

actions.description: Fetch a GitHub issue. Exactly one repository selector must be populated.

repository_id.description: Numeric GitHub repository ID; use when stable repository id is available.

repository_url.description: GitHub repository or nested repository URL; supports GitHub Enterprise Server custom hostnames and GHE.com API hosts.

conditionalRules: Exactly one of repository_full_name, repository_id, repository_url is required; XOR is descriptive rather than structurally encoded.
actions.resourceScope: GitHub issue selected by full name, numeric repository ID, or supported repository/nested URL.

resultContract.description: Issue model fields are not projected.

actions.description: Fetch comments for a GitHub issue across all pages.
actions.resourceScope: Issue comments for one GitHub issue.

resultContract.description: Comment-array schema, fields, pagination metadata, and completeness marker are not projected.

actions.description: Fetch a pull request with its diff, metadata, and optionally comments.
conditionalRules: Description says comments are optional output content, but no include_comments or condition-controlling input is projected.
actions.resourceScope: Pull request including metadata and diff.

resultContract.description: Contains PR metadata, diff, and optionally comments; exact schemas not projected.

actions.description: Fetch a merged PR discussion timeline combining issue comments, inline review comments, and review submissions into one normalized array.

pagination.note: Unlike fetch_issue_comments, no all-pages guarantee is stated; none is inferred.

actions.resourceScope: Merged pull-request discussion/review timeline over issue comments, inline review comments, and review submissions.

resultContract.description: Semantic result is one normalized array; normalized entry/discriminator/order/ID/author/timestamp/review-state fields are not projected.
